scope: Matched first-connectivity study plus the before/at-closure comparison at delta=0.01; all observations come from the existing experiment.
noise_model: Uniform displacement in [-delta,delta] along clean normal; same signed vector reused across amplitudes.
matching: Same latent points and normal displacement vector across amplitudes within seed.

coordinate_archive.provenance: Deterministic reconstruction from the existing 20 retained seeds and original noise arithmetic; no new sampling streams or persistence calculations.

keys.{seed}_latent: Shape (512,): normalized clean arc length s in [0,1).
keys.{seed}_clean: Shape (512,2): clean Cartesian points on the unit-circumference circle.
keys.{seed}_normal: Shape (512,2): outward unit normal, evaluated as clean * (2*pi) with the original arithmetic.
keys.{seed}_signed_draw: Shape (512,): dimensionless uniform draws in [-1,1], RNG seed seed + 70000003.
keys.{seed}_delta{delta:g}_observed: Shape (512,2): clean + delta * signed_draw[:,None] * normal; delta uses Python g formatting.

coordinate_archive.units: Cartesian coordinates and delta use the unit-circumference curve length; latent coordinates are normalized arc length; normals and signed draws are dimensionless.
coordinate_archive.shared_events: The delta=0.01 arrays are used for first connectivity and the before/at-closure observations.

version_scope: Environment recorded with these saved measurements. Use code/requirements.txt for release summary rebuilding and verification (pandas 2.2.3).
